run_single_conference_job: run a single HF Job for a conference like neurips with retrieval agents
run_all_conferences: run HF Jobs sequentially for all conferences listed in the conferences directory
sync_code_to_hf: upload a code tarball to a private Hugging Face model repo for job execution
build_remote_command: build a bash command script for the HF Job container to clone and run the agent
get_conferences: list all conference names from YAML files in the conferences directory
